lines.zh: 八条腿跑起来，像敲鼓。
lines.en: Eight legs running sound like a drum.

lines.zh: 我跑得不直，自己也不明白。
lines.en: I do not run straight, and I do not know why.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩在落叶上，沙沙响。
lines.en: Hooves rustle on the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我一会儿冲前，一会儿拐弯。
lines.en: I dart forward, then swerve for no reason.

lines.zh: 鼻子贴着地，我在找蘑菇。
lines.en: Nose to the ground, I hunt for mushrooms.

lines.zh: 腿太多，拐弯时打架。
lines.en: With so many legs, they trip over each other on turns.

lines.zh: 我爬上树干，倒着走。
lines.en: I climb a trunk and walk upside down.

lines.zh: 猪的身子，蜘蛛的脚步，很轻。
lines.en: A pig's body on spider feet moves lightly.

lines.zh: 我踩过泥坑，溅了一身。
lines.en: I cross a mud pit and splash myself.

lines.zh: 忽然停住，又忽然冲出去。
lines.en: I stop dead, then bolt off again.

lines.zh: 草叶在我腿间弹来弹去。
lines.en: Grass blades spring between my legs.

lines.zh: 我跟着一只猪走了一段。
lines.en: I followed a pig for a while.

lines.zh: 我的影子有八条细腿。
lines.en: My shadow has eight thin legs.

lines.zh: 走累了，我就横着挪。
lines.en: When tired, I shuffle sideways.

lines.zh: 我撞开灌木，头也不回。
lines.en: I crash through the bushes without looking back.

lines.zh: 蹄子和爪一起落地，声音很乱。
lines.en: Hooves and claws land together, a messy sound.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子抽动，闻见远处的泥。
lines.en: My snout twitches at distant mud.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛，有的在看天。
lines.en: Eight eyes, and some are looking at the sky.

lines.zh: 我哼哼两声，又吱吱叫。
lines.en: I grunt twice, then chitter.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，腿收在身子下面。
lines.en: I crouch with my legs tucked beneath me.

lines.zh: 丝从肚子后面拉出来，粘住草。
lines.en: Silk trails from my rear and sticks to grass.

lines.zh: 我嚼着一片叶子，嚼了很久。
lines.en: I chew one leaf for a very long time.

lines.zh: 忽然忘了自己要去哪。
lines.en: I suddenly forget where I was going.

lines.zh: 我用后腿挠耳朵，挠不到。
lines.en: I scratch an ear with a hind leg and miss.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的毛全立起来。
lines.en: The wind rises, and all my bristles stand up.

lines.zh: 我数自己的腿，总是数乱。
lines.en: I count my legs and always lose track.

lines.zh: 闻到发酵蛛眼，我抬起了头。
lines.en: I smell fermented spider eye and look up.

lines.zh: 我趴在石头上，像会呼吸的泥。
lines.en: I lie on a rock like breathing mud.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有泥，我想闻。
lines.en: Your boots have mud on them; I want to sniff.

lines.zh: 你手上拿着胡萝卜吗？
lines.en: Are you holding a carrot?

lines.zh: 我八只眼一起看你，别怕。
lines.en: All eight eyes look at you; do not be afraid.

lines.zh: 你个子高，我得仰头。
lines.en: You are tall, so I have to look up.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就当你是树。
lines.en: Stand still and I will take you for a tree.

lines.zh: 你身上有药水的味道。
lines.en: You smell of potions.

lines.zh: 我在想，能不能爬上你的肩。
lines.en: I wonder if I could climb onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的影子动了，我跟着抖。
lines.en: Your shadow moved, and I twitched with it.

lines.zh: 你眼睛只有两只，真少。
lines.en: Only two eyes? That is so few.

lines.zh: 你往后退，我就往前挪。
lines.en: You step back, and I creep forward.

lines.zh: 一条腿被打断，我还能跑。
lines.en: One leg is broken, and I can still run.

lines.zh: 我吱了一声，比猪叫尖。
lines.en: I squeal, sharper than a pig's cry.

lines.zh: 你打中我的肚子，我缩起来。
lines.en: You hit my belly, and I curl up.

lines.zh: 我的丝囊被打到了，黏糊糊。
lines.en: You hit my silk sac; it is sticky.

lines.zh: 这一下让我乱了方向。
lines.en: That blow scrambled my sense of direction.

lines.zh: 我退到墙上，开始往上爬。
lines.en: I back to the wall and start climbing.

lines.zh: 伤口不深，我的腿在抖。
lines.en: The wound is shallow, but my legs shake.

lines.zh: 你打到我的鼻子，我最讨厌。
lines.en: You hit my snout, and I hate that most.

lines.zh: 我掉了一只眼睛，还有七只。
lines.en: I lost one eye; seven remain.

lines.zh: 我绕着你跑，边跑边叫。
lines.en: I run circles around you, squealing.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜！我鼻子先知道了。
lines.en: Carrots! My nose knew before I did.

lines.zh: 发酵的蛛眼，味道冲得我发晕。
lines.en: Fermented spider eye hits my nose and dizzies me.

lines.zh: 你手里那瓶药水，是给我的吗？
lines.en: That potion in your hand, is it for me?

lines.zh: 泥坑那边，我想去滚一圈。
lines.en: Over by the mud pit, I want to roll once.

lines.zh: 甜菜根也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Beetroot will do too; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 你摇着胡萝卜，我的腿自己跑。
lines.en: You wave a carrot, and my legs run on their own.

lines.zh: 那株蘑菇长得正好。
lines.en: That mushroom is just the right size.

lines.zh: 我闻见 Chemical X 的味了。
lines.en: I can smell Chemical X in the air.

lines.zh: 你把东西放地上，我就过来。
lines.en: Put it on the ground, and I will come.

lines.zh: 猪食槽！我很久没见了。
lines.en: A pig trough! I have not seen one in ages.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，八条腿全乱了。
lines.en: I bump you and all eight legs tangle.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子撞扁了一点，没事。
lines.en: My snout got a little flat; it is fine.

lines.zh: 你被我绊了一下，我也绊了。
lines.en: You tripped on me, and I tripped too.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl right past your legs.

lines.zh: 挤一挤，我这边还有空。
lines.en: Squeeze in; there is room on my side.

lines.zh: 我身上的泥蹭到你袖子上。
lines.en: My mud rubbed onto your sleeve.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的丝粘住你了。
lines.en: One bump, and my silk sticks to you.

lines.zh: 别踩我的腿，会断的。
lines.en: Do not step on my legs; they snap.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，都往后退。
lines.en: We collide, and both back away.

lines.zh: 我从你胯下钻过去，很快。
lines.en: I slip between your legs, quick as that.

lines.zh: 我用丝把窝织在树根下。
lines.en: I weave a nest of silk under the roots.

lines.zh: 它用鼻子拱我，我就跟着走。
lines.en: It nudges me with its snout, and I follow.

lines.zh: 两只蜘猪对着哼哼，很吵。
lines.en: Two spider-pigs grunting at each other is loud.

lines.zh: 我把最好的蘑菇留给她。
lines.en: I save the best mushroom for her.

lines.zh: 我们的腿缠在一起，走不动。
lines.en: Our legs tangle, and we cannot move.

lines.zh: 她织网，我守着入口。
lines.en: She weaves the web, and I guard the entrance.

lines.zh: 我给她舔掉背上的泥。
lines.en: I lick the mud off her back.

lines.zh: 窝里铺着干草和旧丝。
lines.en: The nest is lined with dry grass and old silk.

lines.zh: 小的刚出生就会跑，真快。
lines.en: The little ones run at birth, so fast.

lines.zh: 我们并排趴在石头上晒太阳。
lines.en: We lie side by side on a warm rock.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起胡萝卜，跑了。
lines.en: I snatch the carrot in my mouth and run.

lines.zh: 丝线缠住一块铁，我拖着。
lines.en: Silk wraps an iron piece, and I drag it.

lines.zh: 我捡起蘑菇，塞进腮边的囊。
lines.en: I pick up a mushroom and stuff it in my cheek.

lines.zh: 这块骨头不错，我留着磨牙。
lines.en: This bone is good; I keep it for gnawing.

lines.zh: 我捡到一把生锈的剪刀。
lines.en: I found a pair of rusty shears.

lines.zh: 东西太小，我腿粗，抓不住。
lines.en: The thing is tiny; my legs are too thick to grip.

lines.zh: 我用丝把东西吊在树上。
lines.en: I hang my find from a tree with silk.

lines.zh: 这顶帽子，我戴在鼻子上。
lines.en: This hat, I wear it on my snout.

lines.zh: 亮晶晶的，我叼回去给窝。
lines.en: Something shiny; I carry it back to the nest.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗蛋，差点咬碎。
lines.en: I pick up an egg and nearly crush it.

lines.zh: 你动了一下，八只眼都转过去。
lines.en: You moved once, and all eight eyes turn.

lines.zh: 我先爬高，从上面看你。
lines.en: I climb high first and look down at you.

lines.zh: 你的味道里有铁和汗。
lines.en: Your smell has iron and sweat in it.

lines.zh: 我忽然想打你，没理由。
lines.en: I suddenly want to fight you, for no reason.

lines.zh: 你踩断树枝，那就暴露了。
lines.en: You snapped a twig; that gave you away.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，腿都绷紧了。
lines.en: I lower my body and every leg goes taut.

lines.zh: 你在那边，我先吐点丝。
lines.en: You are over there; let me spit some silk first.

lines.zh: 目标会跑，我最喜欢会跑的。
lines.en: The target runs; I love the ones that run.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面，你没注意。
lines.en: I slip to your side; you did not notice.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，其实在算距离。
lines.en: I stand still, actually calculating distance.

lines.zh: 那个拿火把的，先躲开火。
lines.en: The one with a torch; I avoid the flame first.

lines.zh: 你的喘气变急了，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing grows hurried, and I can hear it.

lines.zh: 你还没跑，我已经爬到那边了。
lines.en: Before you run, I have already climbed over there.

lines.zh: 我从树上垂下来，正好在你头顶。
lines.en: I dangle from the tree right above your head.

lines.zh: 我的丝粘着你的脚后跟。
lines.en: My silk clings to your heel.

lines.zh: 你转圈找我，我就在你背后。
lines.en: You spin looking for me; I am behind you.

lines.zh: 我跳一下，换个角度。
lines.en: I hop once to change the angle.

lines.zh: 你别看地上，上面才危险。
lines.en: Do not watch the ground; above is the danger.

lines.zh: 我的腿在数你的步子。
lines.en: My legs are counting your steps.

lines.zh: 你停下，我八条腿就开始动。
lines.en: When you halt, all eight of my legs start moving.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在哪，我就去哪。
lines.en: Where your shadow falls, I go.

lines.zh: 我装作走开，其实没走。
lines.en: I pretend to leave, but I do not.

lines.zh: 你举盾挡前面，我从下面来。
lines.en: Shield up front; I come from below.

lines.zh: 我讨厌被盯着，所以我先动。
lines.en: I hate being watched, so I move first.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，蹄子先到。
lines.en: I pounce, and the hooves land first.

lines.zh: 前腿一蹬，把你撞开。
lines.en: A shove from my front legs knocks you aside.

lines.zh: 我咬一口，牙不整齐。
lines.en: I bite once with crooked teeth.

lines.zh: 丝喷到你脸上，你睁不开眼。
lines.en: Silk sprays your face, and you cannot open your eyes.

lines.zh: 我从你膝后顶过去，你腿一软。
lines.en: I butt the back of your knee, and your leg buckles.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，整个身子砸下来。
lines.en: I leap and drop my whole weight on you.

lines.zh: 这一脚太快，我自己都没看清。
lines.en: That kick was so fast I did not see it either.

lines.zh: 你被我粘住，动一下都难。
lines.en: You are stuck to my silk and can barely move.

lines.zh: 我边打边绕，不让你正面挡。
lines.en: I strike while circling so you cannot block.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子撞你，也很疼。
lines.en: My snout hitting you hurts too.

lines.zh: 碗里的 Chemical X 泼下来，我变了。
lines.en: The Chemical X spills, and I change.

lines.zh: 刚吃完发酵蛛眼，肚子就烧起来。
lines.en: I just ate fermented spider eye; my belly burns.

lines.zh: 腿从身体两侧冒出来，撑开毛。
lines.en: Legs push out from my sides and part the bristles.

lines.zh: 我先学会的是爬墙。
lines.en: The first thing I learned was climbing walls.

lines.zh: 我落地时，八条腿一起响。
lines.en: I land, and all eight legs click at once.

lines.zh: 我原来的圈，现在关不住我。
lines.en: My old pen cannot hold me now.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻自己，味道全变了。
lines.en: I sniff myself; the smell is all wrong.

lines.zh: 我试着哼哼，发出的却是吱声。
lines.en: I try to grunt, and a chitter comes out.

lines.zh: 天旋地转，然后我就跑起来了。
lines.en: The world spun, and then I was running.

lines.zh: 我第一个看见的是泥坑。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was a mud pit.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的丝，味道很难闻。
lines.en: Fire catches my silk, and the smell is awful.

lines.zh: 从墙上摔下来，腿压在一起。
lines.en: I fall off the wall with my legs crushed together.

lines.zh: 水里我的丝不管用。
lines.en: In water my silk is useless.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到树上。
lines.en: The blast throws me up into a tree.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的腿间，没中。
lines.en: An arrow passes between my legs and misses.

lines.zh: 药水光一照，我的腿发软。
lines.en: Potion light hits me and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 饿起来，我连蛛网都嚼。
lines.en: When hungry, I even chew cobwebs.

lines.zh: 雷劈在树上，我掉了下来。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree, and I drop down.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，八条腿乱抓。
lines.en: No ground below; all eight legs claw at air.
